segments.text: Lesson 42
segments.translation: 第42课

segments.text: Recording an earthquake
segments.translation: 记录地震

segments.text: Listen to the tape then answer this question.
segments.translation: 听录音，然后回答问题。

segments.text: What does a pen have to do to record on paper the vibrations generated by an earthquake?
segments.translation: 钢笔需要做什么才能在纸上记录地震产生的振动？

segments.text: An earthquake comes like a thief in the night, without warning.
segments.translation: 地震如同夜间的窃贼，毫无预警地到来。

segments.text: It was necessary, therefore, to invent instruments that neither slumbered nor slept.
segments.translation: 因此，有必要发明既不打盹也不睡觉的仪器。

segments.text: Some devices were quite simple.
segments.translation: 有些装置相当简单。

segments.text: One, for instance, consisted of rods of various lengths and thicknesses which would stand up on end like ninepins.
segments.translation: 例如，有一种装置由不同长度和粗细的杆组成，它们能像九柱戏的木柱一样竖立着。

segments.text: When a shock came, it shook the rigid table upon which these stood.
segments.translation: 当震动来临时，它会摇动这些杆子所在的刚性桌子。

segments.text: If it were gentle, only the more unstable rods fell.
segments.translation: 如果震动轻微，只有较不稳定的杆子会倒下。

segments.text: If it were severe, they all fell.
segments.translation: 如果震动剧烈，它们都会倒下。

segments.text: Thus the rods, by falling, and by the direction in which they fell,
segments.translation: 因此，这些杆子通过倒下以及倒下的方向，

segments.text: recorded for the slumbering scientist the strength of a shock that was too weak to waken him,
segments.translation: 为沉睡的科学家记录了太弱而无法唤醒他的震动的强度，

segments.text: and the direction from which it came.
segments.translation: 以及它传来的方向。

segments.text: But instruments far more delicate than that were needed if any really serious advance was to be made.
segments.translation: 但如果要取得真正重大的进展，就需要比那精密得多的仪器。

segments.text: The ideal to be aimed at was to devise an instrument that could record with a pen on paper,
segments.translation: 理想的目标是设计一种能用笔在纸上记录的仪器，

segments.text: the movements of the ground or of the table as the quake passed by.
segments.translation: 当地震经过时地面或桌子的运动。

segments.text: While I write my pen moves, but the paper keeps still.
segments.translation: 我写字时笔移动，但纸保持不动。

segments.text: With practice, no doubt, I could in time learn to write by holding the pen still while the paper moved.
segments.translation: 毫无疑问，通过练习，我最终能学会在纸移动时握笔不动来写字。

segments.text: That sounds a silly suggestion,
segments.translation: 这听起来是个愚蠢的建议，

segments.text: but that was precisely the idea adopted in some of the early instruments (seismometers) for recording earthquake waves.
segments.translation: 但这正是早期一些地震仪记录地震波时所采用的想法。

segments.text: But when table, penholder and paper are all moving, how is it possible to write legibly?
segments.translation: 但当桌子、笔架和纸都在移动时，怎么能写得清楚呢？

segments.text: The key to a solution of that problem lay in an everyday observation.
segments.translation: 解决这个问题的关键在于一个日常观察。

segments.text: Why does a person standing in a bus or train tend to fall when a sudden start is made?
segments.translation: 为什么站在公交车或火车上的人在突然启动时容易摔倒？

segments.text: It is because his feet move on, but his head stays still.
segments.translation: 这是因为他的脚继续前进，但头部保持不动。

segments.text: A simple experiment will help us a little further.
segments.translation: 一个简单的实验会帮助我们进一步理解。

segments.text: Tie a heavy weight at the end of a long piece of string.
segments.translation: 在一根长绳的末端系上一个重物。

segments.text: With the hand held high in the air, hold the string so that the weight nearly touches the ground.
segments.translation: 手高举在空中，握住绳子使重物几乎接触地面。

segments.text: Now move the hand to and fro and around but not up and down.
segments.translation: 现在让手来回和左右移动，但不要上下移动。

segments.text: It will be found that the weight moves but slightly or not at all.
segments.translation: 会发现重物只轻微移动或根本不动。

segments.text: Imagine a pen attached to the weight in such a way that its point rests upon a piece of paper on the floor.
segments.translation: 想象一支笔附在重物上，使其笔尖搁在地板上的一张纸上。

segments.text: Imagine an earthquake shock shaking the floor, the paper, you and your hand.
segments.translation: 想象一次地震震动了地板、纸张、你和你的手。

segments.text: In the midst of all this movement, the weight and the pen would be still.
segments.translation: 在所有这些运动中，重物和笔会保持静止。

segments.text: But as the paper moved from side to side under the pen point, its movement would be recorded in ink upon its surface.
segments.translation: 但当纸在笔尖下来回移动时，它的运动会被墨水记录在纸面上。

segments.text: It was upon this principle that the first instruments were made, but the paper was wrapped round a drum which rotated slowly.
segments.translation: 最初的仪器就是基于这个原理制造的，但纸是包裹在一个缓慢旋转的鼓上。

segments.text: As long as all was still, the pen drew a straight line,
segments.translation: 只要一切静止，笔就画一条直线，

segments.text: but while the drum was being shaken, the line that the pen was drawing wriggled from side to side.
segments.translation: 但当鼓被摇动时，笔画出的线就左右扭动。

segments.text: The apparatus thus described, however,
segments.translation: 然而，这样描述的仪器，

segments.text: records only the horizontal component of the wave movement, which is, in fact, much more complicated.
segments.translation: 只记录了波浪运动的水平分量，而实际上运动要复杂得多。

segments.text: If we could actually see the path described by a particle,
segments.translation: 如果我们能看到一个粒子描绘的路径，

segments.text: such as a sand grain in the rock,
segments.translation: 比如岩石中的沙粒，

segments.text: it would be more like that of a bluebottle buzzing round the room; it would be up and down, to and fro and from side to side.
segments.translation: 它会更像一只苍蝇在房间里嗡嗡飞；会上下、来回、左右移动。

segments.text: Instruments have been devised and can be so placed that all three elements can be recorded in different graphs.
segments.translation: 已设计出仪器，并可以这样放置，使三个要素都能记录在不同的图表上。

segments.text: When the instrument is situated at more than 700 miles from the earthquake centre,
segments.translation: 当仪器位于距震中700多英里处时，

segments.text: the graphic record shows three waves arriving one after the other at short intervals.
segments.translation: 图表记录显示三个波依次以短暂间隔到达。

segments.text: The first records the arrival of longitudinal vibrations.
segments.translation: 第一个记录纵波的到达。

segments.text: The second marks the arrival of transverse vibrations which travel more slowly and arrive several minutes after the first.
segments.translation: 第二个标志着横波的到达，它们传播较慢，在第一个之后几分钟到达。

segments.text: These two have travelled through the earth.
segments.translation: 这两种波穿过了地球。

segments.text: It was from the study of these that so much was learnt about the interior of the earth.
segments.translation: 正是通过对这些波的研究，人们了解了地球内部的许多知识。

segments.text: The third, or main wave is the slowest and has travelled round the earth through the surface rocks.
segments.translation: 第三个或主波是最慢的，它通过地表岩石绕地球传播。
